selected_branches.branch: Continuation toward sidewalk conditional on lawful prior entry

law_text: Except as otherwise provided in NRS 484B.287 [NRS-484B-287-1c, NRS-484B-287-1d, NRS-484B-287-1e, LVMC-11-30-060-A, LVMC-11-30-060-B], 484B.290 [LVMC-11-30-140-B] and 484B.350 [LVMC-11-46-030]: Whenever signals exhibiting the words “Walk,” “Don’t Walk,” “Wait” or similar symbols are in place, such signals indicate as follows: While the “Don’t Walk” or “Wait” indication or an upraised hand symbol is illuminated and flashing but is not accompanied by a countdown timer, a pedestrian may not proceed to cross the highway, but a pedestrian who entered the highway lawfully pursuant to subparagraph (1) [NRS-484B-283-1d1] may continue to cross the highway but must proceed to a curb, sidewalk, safety zone if one is provided or other place of safety before the “Don’t Walk” or “Wait” indication or an upraised hand symbol is illuminated and steady.

witness_review.branch: Continuation toward sidewalk conditional on lawful prior entry
required_context: Construct distinct connected trail, crossing and sidewalk segments; preserve trail access restrictions.
Do not substitute an invented safety criterion for the enumerated sidewalk destination.
Establish highway boundaries and the sidewalk's statutory location, intended pedestrian use and accessibility.
Establish sidewalk status and accessibility and retain arrival observations.
Establish supported connections among trail, sidewalk and pedestrian route, including the actual highway crossing.
Preserve trail access restrictions, opening exceptions and unresolved references.
Provide the governing illuminated flashing indication without countdown and its steady transition.
Record entry and earlier signal history without asserting lawful entry under the missing subparagraph (1).
Retain prior Walk indication, signal-facing direction, entry history, flashing interval, arrival observations and transition to steady.
Use the supplied NRS-484B-283-1d1 text to assess the entry prerequisites while leaving lawful entry and opening-exception applicability unresolved.
witness_review.reason: A trail-connected travel route can include a highway crossing toward the fixed sidewalk while the signal changes from flashing to steady.
